# proxmox_sdn_fabric_node (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN fabric node from `/cluster/sdn/fabrics/node/{fabric_id}/{node_id}`. Fields without a typed counterpart stay in `pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_fabric_node" "node1" {
  fabric_id = proxmox_sdn_fabric.ospf.fabric_id
  node_id   = "node1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_id` (String) Fabric that owns the node.
- `node_id` (String) Node entry to read.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_ips` (List of String)
- `endpoint` (String)
- `id` (String) Fabric node identifier (`<fabric_id>/<node_id>`).
- `interfaces` (List of String)
- `ip` (String)
- `ip6` (String)
- `peers` (List of String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `role` (String)
- `state` (String)
